name: Recruiter Outreach
description: Writes a LinkedIn message or email to a recruiter that clearly communicates the user's target role, availability, and key qualifications in a concise format optimized for recruiter workflows. Produces ready-to-send message text. Use when the user wants to message a recruiter, respond to a recruiter's outreach, or proactively connect with recruiters in their field. Do NOT use for cold emails to hiring managers (use cold-outreach-email), networking or informational interview messages (use networking-message-writer), or LinkedIn profile writing (use linkedin-summary-writer).
